decoder_heldout_inputs: 20 prices at the window's anchor snapshot
comparison_protocol.ar_initialisation: Uniform bootstrap of training-window histories; last p rows used by VAR(p).
comparison_protocol.timegan_initialisation: Generate feature windows from noise; do not encode validation histories or futures.
comparison_protocol.pairing: Generated sample i is paired with chronological real window i.
comparison_protocol.window_policy: Non-overlapping sequence_length-update windows with at least reference_history_length past within-split features.
comparison_protocol.selection: Lowest seed-mean invalid rate, then mean KL, ACF error, p and ridge; SSIM is reported, not a tie-breaker.
prohibited: held-out feature histories as generator inputs
repairing or dropping invalid generated books
comparison_protocol.scope: Anchored feature generation, not forecasting the particular observed future or generating starting prices.

preprocessing_scaler.method: per-feature min-max, training period only, no clipping

ssim_controls.meaning: Identity checks the metric; shuffled real diagnoses pairing sensitivity, not a ceiling or selection criterion.

depth_ssim.images: Separate ask and bid images, each 10 levels x sequence_length updates; levels 1 through 10.
depth_ssim.aggregation: Mean over valid 7x7 windows, then equal mean of sides, sequences and generation seeds.
depth_ssim.clipping: none; negative or above-training-range depths stay in the score and validity checks
depth_ssim.reference_range: Nominal training reference range [0, 1]; fixed even for held-out or generated extremes.
depth_ssim.variant: Wang et al. SSIM equation; 7x7 uniform windows/sample covariance, not the paper's 11x11 Gaussian setting.

selection_rule: Lexicographic: lowest seed-mean invalid rate, then mean KL, then ACF MAE, then p and ridge.
limitations: Main anchor_only_v1 comparison supplies only observed starting prices to the decoder; AR initial histories come from training.
observed_history_v1 supplies actual validation histories and is a separate conditional experiment, not the TimeGAN comparison.
All weights, residuals, scaling and histogram boundaries use training only; validation selects hyperparameters.
Existing preprocessing reads/audits the full day; no test model metrics or test-based choices are computed.
Invalid finite books remain in all distribution and ACF metrics. No clipping, sorting, rounding or repair.
Seed standard deviations measure innovation sampling variability, not independent days or confidence intervals.
KL depends on the declared binning and smoothing; 32-update ACF only measures short event-time dependence.
Depth SSIM uses fixed chronological pairing and the declared 7x7 uniform-window variant. It measures volumes, not price validity.
Teacher-forced one-step validation MSE is a separate observed-history diagnostic, not main generation performance.
Final test comparison is pending. TimeGAN has not been trained or evaluated.
The lowest invalid rate is ranked first even when another candidate has lower KL or one-step MSE.
Candidate fit time includes an equal share of the order's SVD setup plus its own ridge solve/residual calculation.
Rollout timing excludes decoding and IO. Historical refactor timings cover one observed-history grid without SSIM, not the new two-protocol run.

fit.solver: CPU float64 SVD least squares; unpenalised intercept
fit.ridge_objective: mean over training pairs of squared vector error + ridge * sum(weight ** 2)
fit.fit_scope: All consecutive feature pairs within training; includes pairs between windows and the trailing rows.
fit.context_scope: Training window starts after the first window; paired previous features and same-state price anchors.
limitations: Training MSE is an in-sample fit statistic, not validation or simulation quality.
Joint empirical residuals retain simultaneous dependencies but are sampled independently over time.
No price-ladder, spread or non-negative-volume constraints are enforced.
A spectral radius below one describes linear mean dynamics, not validity of generated order books.
Validation/test files are loaded by the existing audit, but no held-out features enter fitting or contexts.

generation.timing_scope: Feature rollout only; excludes model loading, context selection, decoding, file IO and plotting.
generation.initial_state_policy: Paired previous feature and price anchor sampled from training; all returned updates generated.
generation.status: Fit/save/reload/generate smoke test only; no held-out quality evaluation.

initial_experiment.scope: Preserved original AR(1) training-context smoke test; not the current validation run.

historical_validation.selection_rule: Lexicographic: lowest seed-mean invalid rate, then mean KL, then ACF MAE, then p and ridge.
limitations: Conditional 32-update simulations: observed validation history and price anchors are supplied at every window.
All weights, residuals, scaling and histogram boundaries use training only; validation selects hyperparameters.
Existing preprocessing reads/audits the full day; no test model metrics or test-based choices are computed.
Invalid finite books remain in all distribution and ACF metrics. No clipping, sorting, rounding or repair.
Seed standard deviations measure innovation sampling variability, not independent days or confidence intervals.
KL depends on the declared binning and smoothing; 32-update ACF only measures short event-time dependence.
Depth SSIM and final test comparison are pending. TimeGAN has not been trained or evaluated.
The lowest invalid rate is ranked first even when another candidate has lower KL or one-step MSE.
Fit and rollout timings exclude preprocessing/decoding/IO; one CPU fit per candidate, not repeated benchmarks.

benchmark.scope: Three sequential grids per implementation on the same CPU; CSV loading and saving included; plotting and process startup excluded.
